record.name: Resolve active Health applicants without duplicating answers
record.statement: Effective page requirements, active product/applicant elections and product journey policies determine online Health participation. Combined questionnaire assignments can suppress superseded questionnaires; a child election never creates adult answers. Question grouping shares structure, not answers: generic scalar keys and detail collections remain separate for each adult; configured policies use their stable question, field and collection identities. Hidden answers are retained without validating or treating them as active. Restored active detail rows receive the same field checks and configured collection limits as newly entered rows. Each of the five Health pages permits Site page-title/introduction overrides only; generic question numbering and condition-details headings remain global. Medical questions and follow-up fields are controlled by shared questionnaire definitions. Ordinary Site field overrides cannot change their wording, visibility, requiredness, choices or validation. Assigned questionnaire variants and product/state/applicant rules determine applicability; source-defined optional follow-up fields remain optional. QD screen content remains provider-owned. Health pages and supplied source-form previews do not show page-help chips. External image handoffs replace the portal viewport. Association-scoped questionnaire assignments use the canonical effective Site Association selection (fixed, URL or user-selected), not a Yes/No membership answer or a retained association answer.
record.source: User Health configuration decision November 16, 2026; User Health copy decision November 15, 2026; Health final audit November 13, 2026; src/config/flowGates.ts; src/config/healthFollowUps.ts; src/domain/configuredHealthQuestionnaire.ts; src/domain/healthQuestionnaire.ts

record.name: Collect payment for applicable selected products
record.statement: Payment collects details for current selected products/applicants using effective product methods, frequencies, collection and locking. Each product has one election for its participating applicants; separate products retain independent choices unless shared configuration or policy synchronization applies. Required collection has no opt-in; optional collection requires the opt-in answer and collects only on Yes; none collects nothing. Next validates and saves through the shared form frame, then continues to the configured signing step. Payment does not authorize, charge or submit the application. Category/product presentation follows shared configured order. Applicable optional-payment opt-in, product/shared method and frequency, and bank-detail/authorization fields are globally included and required. Fixed field formats and canonical choice definitions cannot be changed through Site field overrides; effective payment policies own available methods, method-specific frequencies, defaults, locking and synchronization. Sites retain field label overrides. Runtime applicability still hides opt-in for required collection, all collection fields for none or optional No, and banking unless an active collecting product selects Bank account.
record.source: src/pages/Payment.tsx; src/domain/sharedPaymentChoices.ts; src/domain/paymentPolicy.ts; requirements/mappings/page-fields/payment.json; User Payment configuration decision November 16, 2026

record.name: Document Review content and retain stable answers
record.statement: Global content keys own page headings, guidance, remaining-step labels, section labels, edit-dialog copy and field/validation labels. Only the page title and introduction have Review Site content slots. Preview your application and Read and consent section headings/descriptions remain global, as do advisor/remaining-step guidance and system wording. Shared policy configuration owns legal wording/applicability, inherited or overridden by the effective Site, independently of the page copy slots. Acknowledgement and conditional policy-field labels, inclusion, requiredness and formats are global; no Site field overrides are permitted. Existing optional dividend identity defaults remain optional. Review preview-page scope belongs to the global page definition. Store review-self-consent and review-spouse-consent independently, plus applicable canonical policy-field answers. Preview groups and legal text are projections, never a second editable application copy. Application document preview omits the prepared-on timestamp. Boolean readouts use the effective field choice label where available, otherwise the shared global Yes/No choices; they do not have separate document-preview CMS records.
record.source: User Review copy decision November 15, 2026; Review final audit November 13, 2026; Master Client Requirements v78, Read & Sign; existing confirmed consent/authorization decisions

record.name: Keep Profile content and answers in the shared model
record.statement: Global Profile content keys own titles, section names, Other coverage note, modal labels, summary labels, totals and validation copy. Only the page title and introduction have Profile Site content slots. Personal information, Other coverage and Financial questionnaire headings, plus the Other coverage note, remain global and are reused for applicable member/spouse sections. Effective field overrides retain supported personal label, inclusion, requiredness and option changes. Physician fields, Financial questionnaire and Other coverage question definitions are global and reject Site field overrides; carrier labels retain their separately approved configuration while all four record fields stay included/required; physician component wording, legal notices, calculation labels and validation retain their existing shared/global contracts. Stable self/spouse scalar keys and selfDisabilityCompanies/spouseDisabilityCompanies arrays retain independent people and record value mappings. Physician details describe a third party and do not request member browser autofill.
record.source: User Profile copy decision November 15, 2026; User Profile review November 13, 2026; Master Client Requirements v78, Main!R165:S169 and Financial questions!A2:B10; requirements/parked/profile.json

record.name: Stop inline for a disqualifying membership attestation
record.statement: On the Membership page, a disqualifying answer to the applicant's yes/no membership attestation (No for ASCE) immediately shows the non-member feedback, hides the follow-up fields and disables Next. An accepted answer restores the follow-up fields and enables Next. This attestation is the only field allowed to stop a page inline. An unanswered attestation, other fields and other page-level business checks use normal submission validation and the page error alert. The spouse membership question on Eligibility does not inherit this exception. Other configurations’ not-eligible outcomes use the page error on submission rather than the yes/no inline exception.
record.source: docs/requirements-spec/page-review.md; src/pages/Membership.tsx; src/components/membership/MembershipStatus.tsx

record.name: Keep Coverage policy/system copy global and product copy shared
record.statement: Coverage allows Site title/introduction overrides through the shared application-header contract. Limit and eligibility warnings, total-versus-additional coverage instructions and estimate disclaimers retain global wording driven by effective policies/configuration and derived values. They have no free-form Site copy slots. Product/category/rider copy keeps its existing shared product ownership and effective assignments, not Coverage-specific duplicate definitions. Existing approved content-key note selections remain supported. Copy changes do not modify product availability, applicant/rider participation, category/product/featured ordering, benefit limits or defaults, in-force deductions, calculated estimates, validation or navigation. ASCE inherits the global Coverage header and system copy.
record.source: User Coverage copy decision November 15, 2026; requirements/parked/coverage.json; requirements/global/content/coverage.json; shared product/coverage configurations

record.name: Configure Eligibility introductions and applicant notes through shared content slots
record.statement: Global Eligibility owns default title, introduction and member/spouse/child note definitions. Effective Sites may override only these five declared copy slots. The member note defaults empty and is hidden when blank, without introducing a member/You heading. Spouse and child notes retain their global defaults and existing offered/selected applicant participation. Child notice-only mode still requires nonblank child note wording and does not collect child records. Copy overrides never change eligibility, covered people, section participation, child collection/maximum, verification, validation or navigation. Breadcrumbs, loading/navigation labels, validation wording and member-verification dialog copy stay global. Field labels/options and eligibility/TPA settings retain their existing shared configuration owners. ASCE inherits all five values without a new copy assignment.
record.source: User Eligibility configurability decisions November 15, 2026; requirements/parked/eligibility.json#contentSlots; requirements/global/content/eligibility.json; existing EligibilitySections child notice-only guard

record.name: Verify before restoring and apply the correct return context
record.statement: Resume requires an email magic link followed by a six-digit phone code, delivered only by Text or Call to the saved phone; Call maps to transport phone. Display only masked phone information with its last four digits. There is no email-code alternative, including in the local simulator or standard examples. Link and MFA proof, Site, recipient, application, expiry and locks are validated by the service. An invalid, expired, consumed or revoked link returns to initial Resume with its configured inline error. Incorrect, expired or replaced codes remain inline on code entry with appropriate feedback and resend. Successful verification consumes the MFA session, rotates writes, restores that application and entry scope, resets application-session flags and uses the service-authorized actor and lifecycle destination: advisor recovery returns to Eligibility; prepared-application applicant recovery returns to Review before signing or unfinished DocuSign after signing starts. Submitted applications cannot recover. UI flow context cannot grant actor identity or choose an authoritative destination. URL flow context is never authorization. Busy and successful states disable duplicate actions.
record.source: portal_inventory.xlsx, Rules - Resume!C2:D19; user clarifications November 13, 2026; fresh-start global model

record.name: Collect payment details before signing
record.statement: Payment continues to DocuSign through normal form validation and save without a payment authorization, declined-payment simulation or application submission action. Processing and billing occur outside this page; estimates remain fictional and the tax/fee note does not imply calculation, charging, live bank verification or processor integration. Technical failures use the shared error/session model and business or validation issues use page/field feedback, with no separate payment-issue page. The effective Site page requirement controls whether collection is required, optional or disabled; product payment controls apply only when collection is active.
record.source: User Payment decisions November 14, 2026; MCR New UX Multi-page Requirements!AT21; src/pages/Payment.tsx

record.name: Inherit shared Review wording and policy
record.statement: Global Review policy definitions/defaults own fraud, authorization, consent, premium wording and common notice blocks. ASCE explicitly inherits the shared default; an effective Site can assign an override. The compiler resolves the default reference from authored global data, never an older snapshot. Page introduction content is separate and contains no duplicate authorization or consent wording. The global policy definition declares its supported field surface. Policy overrides select legal text, block applicability and documents without redefining shared fields.
record.source: Review final audit November 13, 2026; Master Client Requirements v78, Read & Sign; existing confirmed consent/authorization decisions

record.name: Use one global physician field set with whole-section visibility
record.statement: Physician field definitions, wording, choices, optionality and validation are global and cannot be overridden or individually hidden by a Site. The shared physician-information boolean defaults true. A Site may set it false to hide the entire section for all otherwise applicable adults. Existing applicant participation still applies; disabling the section hides its saved drafts from page validation and read-only output without deleting them. Library retains the shared definitions and configuration.
record.source: User physician clarification November 16, 2026; requirements/global/configurations/profile.json; requirements/parked/profile.json

record.name: Resolve Review statements from active coverage and residence
record.statement: Use active selected product/applicant elections and member residence. The shared underwriting flag is true for member/spouse Life, Disability or Office/Professional Overhead; child-only Life, AD&D and supplemental-health-only elections do not set it. Medical introduction, authorization, underwritten consent and CT warning follow this flag independently of online health-question participation. Jurisdiction wording precedes processing wording, then defaults: Minnesota authorization and post-consent exclusion; Virginia QD authorization and consent; QD DI or QD Life plus DI processing authorization. NY Life-only omits fraud; non-Life or an active accident rider includes it. Missing residence or configured applicant-type prerequisites block Next. This November 13 user decision supersedes the October 20 ASCE health-participation exceptions; historical evidence and other effective-Site policies remain separate.
record.source: User decision November 13, 2026; MCR v78 Read & Sign!B3:B4, B35:B53, B78:B93 and B118:B119

record.name: Resolve SSN requiredness from active product assignments
record.statement: SSN is required by the global field default. A Site can assign optionalForProducts per person: the field becomes optional only when every active product for that applicant is listed. Any additional unlisted election retains the field default. ASCE assigns spouse DI as optional; member SSN remains required. Supplied SSNs always receive the shared format check.
record.source: User Profile review November 13, 2026; Master Client Requirements v78, Main!R165:S169 and Financial questions!A2:B10; requirements/parked/profile.json

record.name: Show configured medical-review guidance only for applicable coverage sent for review
record.statement: Global Receipt owns the standard ExamOne underwriting-review note and its wording defaults. Effective Sites inherit this content; an override is appropriate only for a genuine provider or wording difference. Display a nonempty note only if a selected adult coverage meets the shared product-based underwriting applicability flag and is sent for review: FUW/SI/TELE standard review or an explicit QD referred/database-unavailable outcome. Omit it when all outcomes are conditionally approved or declined, for AD&D or child-only coverage without adult medical-review applicability, or for absent/unrecognized results. The shared wording retains may contact rather than promising an exam. ASCE inherits it without a Site assignment; supporting source evidence does not change global ownership.
record.source: User decision November 14, 2026; MCR v78 New UX Multi-page Requirements!AU21; requirements/global/content/receipt.json; src/domain/receiptPresentation.ts; user global ownership correction November 14, 2026
